annotation.title_clean: UN Regulation No 156 – Uniform provisions concerning the approval of vehicles with regards to software update and software updates management system
annotation.title_en: UN Regulation No 156 – Uniform provisions concerning the approval of vehicles with regards to software update and software updates management system
annotation.authors_or_issuer: United Nations Economic Commission for Europe (UN/ECE) WP.29; published in the Official Journal of the European Union
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union, L 82/60
annotation.summary_en: UN Regulation No 156 (as published in the EU Official Journal) sets uniform type-approval requirements for vehicles regarding software updates, including over-the-air updates. Manufacturers must hold a certified Software Update Management System covering documentation, security, update safety, and user information.
key_provisions_or_claims: Applies to vehicle categories M, N, O, R, S and T that permit software updates.
Manufacturers need a Certificate of Compliance for a Software Update Management System, valid up to three years.
Requires RXSWIN identifiers, auditable registers of software versions and integrity validation data.
OTA updates must be secure, recoverable to a safe state, and not unsafe during driving, with user information.
Approval can be withdrawn for non-conformity; conformity of production is checked every three years.
